title: a16z Podcast: Build Your Personal Brand

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Your brand, says head of a16z marketing and Outcast Agency co-founder Margit Wennmachers.
reader_summary.overview: Your brand, says head of a16z marketing and Outcast Agency co-founder Margit Wennmachers, is what people say about you when you're not in the room. And it's going to happen, whether you choose to have an active part in it or not. But what does this mean at an individual, not just company/product level?

key_points.text: In this episode of the a16z Podcast.
It's not only about "thought leadership", either...
a personal brand can also provide a filter for choosing what to do (and what not to do).
